purpose: Index for public-safe GitHub storage of PMP app-layer lossless quality and Inventory Eyes reports.
writer_name_warning: Do not call this Safe Writer. Safe Writer is already a separate PMP app/code-writing tool.
writer_role: Vault GitHub Writer writes public-safe Inventory Eyes / Lossless Quality reports into the PMP Lossless Inventory Vault.
privacy_rules: Only public app structure, inventory metadata, route status, theme/status findings, and localStorage key names are allowed.

attachment_model.role: support vault for app cleanup, lossless quality, Inventory Eyes, and version-control reports
attachment_model.resident_use: Resident may read this as app-layer context for lossless quality, but must not treat it as private memory or master truth.

write_model.preferred_flow: Improve Lossless Quality creates report -> Copy Lossless Report creates a PMP_LOSSLESS_VAULT_WRITE_PACKET -> Vault GitHub Writer writes packet.report to current_report.
allowed_writers: ChatGPT GitHub connector action approved by user
other private authenticated writer controlled by the user
not_allowed_writers: public GitHub Pages HTML containing a token
public JavaScript containing a GitHub token
any writer that stores private Bug Memory in this vault

next_step: Update the app report export so Copy Lossless Report emits a PMP_LOSSLESS_VAULT_WRITE_PACKET naming this vault target.
